Overview

The MK1.1 provides convenient, organized storage for product boxes and bags, keeping essential packaging within easy reach at either the front counter or drive-thru. Designed to sit neatly beneath the MK1.2 cash drawer, it features magnetic stops for secure, streamlined positioning.
